output.summary: The SLA guarantees 99.5% uptime (3.625 hours downtime/month). With up to 8 hours of scheduled maintenance per month (2 hours/week), total unscheduled+scheduled outage could reach 11.625 hours, exceeding the 60-minute limit. The credit remedy is capped at 10% of the $8,000 fee ($800), which is less than 50% of the monthly fee ($4,000).
